Traditional Nyāya-Mīmāṃsā Structure

Five-Fold Adhikaraṇa Synthesis

Every topic (Adhikaraṇa) in Vidvān is indexed across the classical five-limb hermeneutic framework.

1. विषयः • Viṣaya

The Upaniṣadic passage (Viṣayavākya) or doctrinal subject under inquiry.

2. संशयः • Saṃśaya

The philosophical doubt arising from two plausible readings of the text.

3. पूर्वपक्षः • Pūrvapakṣa

The opponent’s strongest objection (Mīmāṃsā, Sāṅkhya, Nyāya, or Bauddha).

4. सिद्धान्तः • Siddhānta

Śrī Śaṅkarācārya’s established Advaita conclusion grounded in Śruti and Yukti.

5. सङ्गतिः • Saṅgati

Logical connection linking this section to preceding and succeeding Adhikaraṇas.
